# SiteMint

> Official AI & LLM Knowledge Specification for SiteMint (https://sitemint.in)

SiteMint is a digital agency and technology development studio based in India, founded by Yuvraj Singh. It specializes in affordable, high-speed custom website development, Android & iOS mobile applications, video editing/reels, and full social media management for small businesses, startups, coaching institutes, bakeries, and local enterprises in India.

## Core Services & Pricing Packages

### 1. Web & Software Development (Next.js 16 App Router)
- **Starter Package (₹3,999 one-time)**: 5 Pages, mobile-responsive layout, 1-click WhatsApp direct chat integration, contact form email notifications, basic SEO setup, typical turnaround: 5–7 working days.
- **Business Package (₹7,999 one-time)**: 10 Dynamic Pages, Razorpay UPI payment gateway, user dashboard, admin portal, 6 months maintenance support.
- **Professional Package (₹17,999 one-time)**: Unlimited Pages, 1 Year Free Domain (.IN/.COM) + 1 Year High-Speed Cloud Server Included, multi-entity admin, 1 Year technical support.

### 2. Mobile App Development
- Starting ₹12,999 one-time: Native Android (.APK) & iOS Flutter apps, push notifications, cloud backend database, phone OTP authentication.

### 3. Video Editing & Viral Reels
- Starting ₹499/reel: Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, dynamic animated captions, sound effects, B-roll pacing.

### 4. Social Media Management
- Starting ₹4,999/month: Complete brand handling across 7+ platforms (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, Twitter/X), 30 monthly high-res posts & carousels, Meta Ads management.
